responsibility: Implements access to the current Modula-2 language exception state using the RTExceptions runtime. It distinguishes language exceptions by comparing the active exception block against the base language exception block, returns the current M2Exceptions enumeration value when appropriate, and raises the exException diagnostic if queried while not in exceptional execution.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation file for M2EXCEPTION: it contains the RTExceptions-based logic that detects whether the current exception block is a language exception and returns or raises accordingly, whereas M2EXCEPTION.def only declares the exception enumeration and queries.
